sources.name: Brønnøysundregistrene — Enhetsregisteret open API
sources.verdict: VERIFIED this session: fully open HAL/JSON REST API, no auth. Endpoints for enheter, underenheter, organisasjonsformer, and change feeds (/oppdateringer) — ideal for incremental sync. Gold-standard national register API.

sources.name: Brønnøysundregistrene — full dataset downloads
sources.verdict: Bulk gzip JSON download of the entire Enhetsregisteret (all Norwegian legal entities), documented alongside the open API. Not fetched this session but part of the same open-data service; also cataloged on data.norge.no.

sources.name: Foretaksregisteret (Register of Business Enterprises)
sources.verdict: Company-law register (roles, capital, signatories) behind Brreg; role and registration data exposed via the same data.brreg.no API family. Site verified indirectly via brreg.no announcement page fetch.

sources.name: Regnskapsregisteret (Register of Company Accounts)
sources.verdict: Annual accounts for all Norwegian companies. Individual accounts orderable; a machine route exists (regnskapsregisteret API) but terms/auth for bulk not verified this session — flag for adapter research. Financials here are what Proff/Purehelp resell.

sources.name: Løsøreregisteret (Register of Movable Property / charges)
sources.verdict: Security interests/charges over movables — high value for private-debt signals (who is pledging what). Public lookup exists; machine access not verified this session.

sources.name: Finanstilsynet Registry (Virksomhetsregisteret) — search UI
sources.verdict: VERIFIED this session: covers all licensees under FSA supervision — AIFMs (incl. sub-threshold registered AIFMs), AIFs, EuVECA/ELTIF, investment firms, ManCos, and crypto/virtual-currency providers. Reports feature allows filtered downloads by licence type. Updated hourly. Note: since 1 Oct 2025 EEA-passported marketed funds are no longer included.

sources.name: Finanstilsynet Registry API v1
sources.verdict: OAS 3.0 REST API for the full FSA registry (found via search, doc page confirmed to exist). This is the machine route already partially harvested — extend to pull all licence types incl. VASP/crypto registrations.

sources.name: Norges Bank open data API
sources.verdict: Central bank's data API (exchange rates, interest rates, government debt auctions) — SDMX/JSON. Known open service; endpoint itself not fetched this session. ECB-style deterministic FX source for NOK conversion.

sources.name: Statistics Norway (SSB) PxWeb API
sources.verdict: Open statistical API (PxWeb + StatBank) covering credit, banking, property prices, fund holdings, pension-fund balance sheets. Known open API; not fetched this session.

sources.name: Skatteetaten (Norwegian Tax Administration) RSS + open services
sources.verdict: VERIFIED this session: RSS hub page lists feeds for press releases, legal statements, tax appeal board decisions. Useful for regulatory/tax signals affecting fund structuring; VAT register status also queryable via Brreg-linked services.

sources.name: Brønnøysund Kunngjøringer (official announcements — gazette function)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via brreg.no announcements page: Norway's gazette function (company events, liquidations, mergers, bankruptcies) lives here, with an XML-format feed and free daily/weekly subscription. Norway has no separate printed gazette for company events — this is it.

sources.name: Konkursregisteret (Register of Bankruptcies)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search + brreg page: all bankruptcies, compulsory liquidations/dissolutions. Public announcements flow through kunngjøringer (XML available); the JSON konkursvarsel API (DSOP) requires authorization to handle personal ID numbers — company-level announcements are the open route. Dataset also listed on data.norge.no.

sources.name: Norges Domstoler (courts)
sources.verdict: District courts open insolvency proceedings; case-level data is not bulk-open. Use as reference/verification source; not fetched this session.

sources.name: Lovdata
sources.verdict: Statutes, regulations and (partly) court decisions. Free tier covers legislation; case law largely in paid Lovdata Pro. Reference source; not fetched this session.

sources.name: Konkursrådet (Norwegian Bankruptcy Council)
sources.verdict: Insolvency council — guidance, practice notes and practitioner ecosystem around bankruptcy administration. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: Euronext Oslo Børs — issuer lists / market pages
sources.verdict: VERIFIED to exist via search. live.euronext.com is a JS-heavy SPA; issuer/equity lists load via internal JSON endpoints. Euronext also publishes downloadable instrument/issuer lists — adapter should target the underlying JSON, honoring ToS.

sources.name: NewsWeb (Oslo Børs OAM — company disclosures)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED reachable this session but renders as a JS SPA (fetch returned only the 'NewsWeb' shell). This is the officially appointed mechanism for all listed-company announcements — the SPA is backed by a JSON API that an adapter can use; the highest-value corporate-event feed in Norway.

sources.name: Euronext Oslo regulation news
sources.verdict: Exchange regulatory notices (admissions, sanctions, rule changes). URL found via search; not fetched.

sources.name: Euronext Securities Oslo (VPS — CSD)
sources.verdict: Norwegian CSD (former VPS). Shareholder-register data is not open; useful for institutional-service-graph mapping (account operators list). Not fetched this session.

sources.name: NVCA — Norwegian Venture Capital & Private Equity Association members
sources.verdict: VERIFIED this session: 100+ members with websites, categorized into seed/venture funds, corporate ventures, family offices, buyout funds, fund investors (LPs), law firms, fund administrators, advisors — a ready-made map of categories 1 and 6. Already harvested per task hint; the category structure is worth re-harvesting.

sources.name: Finans Norge (Finance Norway)
sources.verdict: Industry association for banks, insurers, pension providers — member list + banking/insurance statistics. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: VFF — Verdipapirfondenes forening (Fund & Asset Management Association)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED this session: publishes monthly market statistics and fund data (AUM > NOK 3,000bn); member list partly behind Medlemsnett but manager universe visible via statistics. Maps Norwegian ManCos/asset managers.

sources.name: Pensjonskasseforeningen (Association of Pension Funds)
sources.verdict: Members = Norwegian occupational pension funds, i.e. the domestic LP base. Not fetched this session; member list expected public.

sources.name: VPFF — Verdipapirforetakenes Forbund (Securities Dealers Association)
sources.verdict: Association of investment firms/brokers — member directory maps execution brokers and corporate-finance houses. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: Finansieringsselskapenes Forening (FinFo — leasing/factoring association)
sources.verdict: Association for finance companies (leasing, factoring, ABL) — specialty-finance mapping for category 2. URL from prior knowledge, NOT verified this session.

sources.name: Norsk Eiendom (real estate industry association)
sources.verdict: Association of property developers/owners — member list maps category 3 entities. URL from prior knowledge, NOT verified this session.

sources.name: Norsk takst (valuers association)
sources.verdict: Norwegian valuers/appraisers association with find-a-valuer directory (RICS-adjacent role in NO market). Not verified this session; RICS global directory also covers Norway.

sources.name: Advokatforeningen — Finn advokat
sources.verdict: Bar association lawyer-search directory — maps fund-structuring/M&A law firms. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: Tilsynsrådet for advokatvirksomhet (Supervisory Council for Legal Practice)
sources.verdict: Official register of practising lawyers/law firms (the regulator-grade counterpart to the bar association). URL from prior knowledge, NOT verified this session.

sources.name: Innovasjon Norge (Innovation Norway)
sources.verdict: State development agency — grant/loan recipients and startup ecosystem signals. Grant award data is public. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: Investinor
sources.verdict: State evergreen VC investor and fund LP — public portfolio and fund-commitment lists. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: Argentum (state PE fund-of-funds) + State of Nordic PE database
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search: Argentum invests in 200+ Nordic PE funds and publishes free 'State of Nordic Private Equity' reports (info.argentum.no) built on its internal market database since 2008 — the single best public window on the Norwegian GP/fund universe.

sources.name: Nysnø Climate Investments
sources.verdict: State climate investment company — portfolio + fund investments public on site. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: Eksfin (Export Finance Norway)
sources.verdict: State export credit/guarantee agency — deal announcements relevant to shipping/energy asset finance. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: Siva (Industrial Development Corporation of Norway)
sources.verdict: State owner of innovation/industrial infrastructure (incubators, industrial estates) — ecosystem + real-assets mapping. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: Enova
sources.verdict: State energy-transition funding agency — project support lists are public, strong signal source for renewables/transition SPVs. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: NBIM — Norges Bank Investment Management (GPFG)
sources.verdict: World's largest SWF; publishes full equity/bond/real-estate/renewables holdings and an RSS feed (RSS page confirmed via search). The unlisted real-estate and renewable-infrastructure holdings are directly relevant to category 3.

sources.name: Folketrygdfondet
sources.verdict: Manages Government Pension Fund Norway — holdings disclosures public. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: Statens pensjonskasse (SPK)
sources.verdict: State occupational pension provider — LP-side institution. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: Doffin — public procurement portal + notices API
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search: national tender database with an Azure API Management developer portal (dof-notices-prod-api.developer.azure-api.net, free subscription key) and an open-data page at doffin.no/data using eForms machine-readable standard. Signals for EPC contractors, concessions, servicer mandates.

sources.name: Miljødirektoratet — Klimakvoteregisteret (EU ETS Norwegian registry)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search: Norwegian Environment Agency administers the national entrance to the EU Union Registry (Norway in EU ETS since 2008). Account-level holdings are in the pan-EU registry; the open machine route for account/compliance data is the EU Transaction Log (EUTL) public downloads filtered to NO accounts.

sources.name: Kartverket — Se eiendom (land register lookup)
sources.verdict: Public property/grunnbok lookup from the mapping authority; per-property ownership visible, bulk access licensed. Not fetched this session — access terms need adapter research before use.

sources.name: data.norge.no (national open-data catalog)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search (Konkursregisteret dataset page found there): the meta-catalog listing all Norwegian public datasets/APIs — use to discover further machine routes.

sources.name: E24
sources.verdict: VERIFIED this session: working RSS (~40 items) covering markets, oil, Norwegian corporates. NOTE: feed header carries explicit licensing restrictions against AI-training/derivative use — headline+link only, per project compliance rules.

sources.name: Dagens Næringsliv (DN)
sources.verdict: Norway's leading business daily. RSS info page confirmed via search; section feeds use pattern dn.no/rss?section=<name> (e.g. dnenergi, stock market, startups). Individual section feed URLs not fetched this session. Content is paywalled — headlines/links only.

sources.name: Finansavisen
sources.verdict: Major markets/finance daily (Hegnar Media). Searched for a public RSS feed — none found; third-party aggregators generate feeds. Paywalled; treat as headline-monitoring target without RSS.

sources.name: Shifter
sources.verdict: The Norwegian startup/VC trade publication (funding rounds, fund closes). Both /rss and /rss/ returned 404 this session — no working feed found; site itself is live. Partly paywalled.

sources.name: Kapital
sources.verdict: Business magazine; publishes the annual '400 richest' list — useful for family-office/HNW mapping. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: FinansWatch
sources.verdict: Watch Media trade daily for banking, insurance, pensions, asset management, fintech, regulation. Fetch was blocked this session (bot protection); subscription-financed. High-relevance vertical — needs polite crawling arrangement.

sources.name: EiendomsWatch
sources.verdict: Watch Media real-estate trade daily — transactions, projects, actors. Existence confirmed via search; site not fetched (sister site blocked fetch). Subscription-based.

sources.name: EnergiWatch
sources.verdict: Watch Media energy trade daily — renewables/transition deal flow. Existence confirmed via search (Watch Media launched EnergiWatch in Norway); not fetched this session.

sources.name: AdvokatWatch
sources.verdict: Watch Media legal-industry daily — law-firm moves and mandates (service-graph signals). URL from prior knowledge, NOT verified this session.

sources.name: Estate Nyheter
sources.verdict: Commercial real-estate news site — existence VERIFIED via search; /rss returned 404 this session, no feed found. Partly open content.

sources.name: Teknisk Ukeblad (TU)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED this session: working RSS covering energy, infrastructure, industrial projects — good for real-assets/energy-transition signals.

sources.name: Europower
sources.verdict: Power-sector trade publication (NHST group) — Norwegian energy market deals and policy. Not fetched this session; subscription-based.

sources.name: Montel News
sources.verdict: Oslo-headquartered European power-market news service — relevant to energy/carbon alts. Subscription; not fetched this session.

sources.name: IntraFish
sources.verdict: Seafood/aquaculture trade press (NHST) — Norway's aquaculture sector is a real-assets/PE deal arena. Subscription; not fetched this session.

sources.name: TradeWinds
sources.verdict: Oslo-based global shipping trade paper (NHST) — shipping finance/asset deals, core Norwegian alt-asset niche. Subscription; not fetched this session.

sources.name: NRK — toppsaker feed
sources.verdict: Public broadcaster; historically offers open RSS feeds incl. toppsaker.rss and per-section feeds. Feed URL from prior knowledge, NOT verified this session — verify before wiring.

sources.name: Norges Bank — press releases + RSS
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search: dedicated RSS-feeds page for press releases, publications, financial stability reports. The rssUrl is the feed-listing page — pick specific feeds from it.

sources.name: Finanstilsynet — news & supervisory announcements
sources.verdict: Licence grants/withdrawals, sanctions, consultations — direct signal source for entity lifecycle events. News section exists (main site fetched this session); RSS availability not confirmed.

sources.name: Regjeringen.no — Ministry of Finance press
sources.verdict: Government portal offers per-ministry RSS; Finance Ministry press covers tax/fund regulation and GPFG policy. RSS service known from prior knowledge, feed IDs NOT verified this session.

sources.name: NTB Kommunikasjon (press-release wire)
sources.verdict: National newswire's press-release distribution — Norwegian corporates and funds publish here; per-publisher pages exist. Machine access/RSS not verified this session.

sources.name: Euronext Oslo — company press releases
sources.verdict: VERIFIED to exist via search; JS-rendered like the rest of live.euronext.com. Overlaps NewsWeb — prefer NewsWeb's underlying JSON as the canonical disclosure feed.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strong on Norwegian LPs (NBIM/GPFG, Folketrygdfondet, KLP, Storebrand, Argentum) and established buyout/infrastructure GPs (FSN, Verdane, HitecVision, Norvestor); fund-level performance where LPs disclose. Thin on sub-threshold AIFMs and niche alts.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Finanstilsynet registry (AIFM/fund licences), NBIM and Folketrygdfondet public holdings/annual reports, Argentum's State of Nordic PE reports, Brreg annual accounts, NVCA membership — all directly accessible to us via the sources above.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Good Norwegian VC/PE deal coverage and cap-table estimates; covers Verdane/Norvestor/HitecVision deal histories and Oslo Børs listings/exits. Estimates (valuations, dry powder) are proprietary modeling.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Brreg filings (share capital changes signal rounds), NewsWeb/Euronext disclosures for listed events, NTB press releases, Shifter/E24/DN deal reporting, NVCA and Argentum statistics — we can hit the same primaries directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad Norwegian startup/scaleup mapping (works with Nordic ecosystem bodies); good on rounds, founders, ecosystem taxonomies. Weak on debt, real assets, service graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Brreg open API for entity data, Shifter and E24 funding coverage, Innovation Norway/Investinor portfolio pages, company self-reporting — the registry and press primaries are open to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Patchy Norway coverage skewed to internationally-visible startups; self-reported plus press-scraped rounds; unreliable for entity completeness.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: English-language press, TechCrunch/Sifted, company submissions. Its gaps (Norwegian-language press, registry data) are exactly what Brreg + Shifter + DN give us directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: The dominant Norwegian company-information site: financials, roles, shareholders for every registered company; Proff Forvalt is the paid credit/prospecting tier. Not alternatives-aware — no fund/asset-class taxonomy.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Entirely built on public data: Brreg Enhetsregisteret/Foretaksregisteret + Regnskapsregisteret accounts + Skatteetaten shareholder register extracts. We go to the same registers at source, at $0.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Free-tier Norwegian company financials and org data, similar to Proff with lighter UX.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Brreg open API + Regnskapsregisteret accounts — same open primaries we already ingest.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Norwegian company-intelligence/credit startup — real-time bankruptcy risk, networks of roles, procurement wins. Closest local analogue to a signals engine, but credit-focused, not alternatives-focused.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Brreg APIs incl. announcement/bankruptcy feeds, Regnskapsregisteret, Doffin procurement data, court announcements — a validation that these open feeds support a commercial intelligence product.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Credit ratings and payment-remark data on Norwegian entities; enterprise market. Payment remarks are licensed, not open.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Brreg registers + accounts as the public backbone; payment remarks from licensed debt-collection sources (not available to us — and personal-data rules keep them out of scope anyway).

competitorAnalysis.platform: Argentum (State of Nordic PE / market database)
competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Semi-competitor: the best free analytical coverage of the Nordic PE/VC fund universe (fundraising, buyout activity, fund lists) since 2008, published as open reports at info.argentum.no.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Own LP data plus GP interviews and public announcements — we can cite its published aggregates and reconstruct the underlying fund list from Finanstilsynet + NVCA + press.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Nordic deal-intelligence service tracking VC rounds and investors incl. Norway; lightweight, press-driven.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Nordic tech press (Shifter, E24, ArcticStartup), press releases — same open press layer we monitor via RSS.

searchedButAbsent: Searched but not found or not confirmable: (1) a working public RSS feed for Shifter (both /rss and /rss/ return 404) and for Finansavisen and Estate Nyheter — none located; (2) a separate Norwegian official gazette for company events — Norsk Lysingsblad's company-announcement role was absorbed by Brønnøysund kunngjøringer, which is the actual gazette route; (3) open bulk access to the beneficial-ownership register (register over reelle rettighetshavere) — exists at Brreg but public machine access is still restricted/phased, consistent with the project's no-open-UBO assumption; (4) an open shareholder register — Skatteetaten's aksjonærregister is only released via annual extracts to media/on request, not an open API; (5) machine access to VPS/Euronext Securities holdings — not public. Session constraint: the web-search budget was exhausted near the end, so several association/agency URLs (FinFo, Norsk Eiendom, Tilsynsrådet, AdvokatWatch, NRK feed URL, regjeringen.no feed IDs) are from prior knowledge and marked unverified in their verdicts rather than dropped; the Finanstilsynet crypto/MiCA register was confirmed only as a licence-type filter inside the main FSA registry rather than as a standalone register page.
